title: He Bullied A Deaf Girl, Then Planned To Disappear, Until She Walked Back Into His Life . . . (A Silent Voice)
caption:
He bullied a deaf girl, then planned to disappear, until she walked back into his life. 😢 A Silent Voice, the full story. Follow for more anime movie recaps!

#asilentvoice #anime #animemovie #animerecap #koenokatachi #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Who carried the heavier guilt in this story, Shoya or Shoko? Tell me below!

segments.say: Shoya Ishida sold everything he owned, and walked to a tall *bridge* to say goodbye to the world.
But before the end, he had one last person to see. The deaf girl he *tormented* as a child.
To see how it got here, go back six years, to a noisy elementary school *classroom*.
Shoya is the loudest, boldest boy in class, and he will do anything to escape being *bored*.
Then a new girl joins the class. Her name is Shoko Nishimiya, and she is *deaf*.
She holds up a notebook. If you want to talk to me, please write it *here*.
At first, the whole class tries hard to help her. But soon, everyone gets *tired*.
Her voice sounds strange to them, and the other kids start to *laugh*.
Shoya sees a new toy, not a classmate. He mocks her, and calls her *names*.
He pulls off her hearing aids, and throws her notebook into dirty *water*.
Shoko never fights back. She just keeps smiling, and keeps saying she is *sorry*.
Each hearing aid costs a fortune. In just five months, eight of them are lost or *broken*.
Her mother calls the school, and the teacher asks the class who is *responsible*.
Every friend Shoya had points straight at him. Suddenly, he is the only one to *blame*.
His mother quietly pays the huge bill, and Shoya's whole world turns *upside down*.
Now the same class that cheered him on treats him like *air*.
One day he snaps, and fights back against a former friend in front of *everyone*.
Shoko leaves the school for good, and Shoya is left alone with what he *did*.
Years pass. Now in high school, he cannot look anyone in the eye. Every face has a big blue *X* on it.
He works hard, he quietly learns sign language, and he pays his mother back every single *yen*.
His last wish is to say sorry to Shoko, just once. And then he will *disappear*.
So he finds her, and gives back her old notebook. Then, with his hands, he signs one word. *Friend*.

segments.text: Um, so, me and Nishimiya, can we be friends?

segments.say: The next morning, his mother learns the truth about his plan, and she is *furious*.
She cries, she holds him tight, and Shoya swears he will never think of it *again*.
He had gone to see Shoko one last time. Instead, he found a reason to *live*.
But at school, Shoya still hides behind those blue X's. Nobody wants to *know* him.
Until a loud, cheerful boy named Tomohiro Nagatsuka shows up with the bicycle he *lost*.
Nagatsuka declares they are best friends. Shoya has never had a friend like that, and he is *stunned*.
Then he meets Shoko again, on a bridge, and they feed the fish *together*.
Her little sister Yuzuru follows them with a camera, ready to *protect* her.
With every visit, the world gets louder again, and the X's start to feel *lighter*.
On a rainy night, Shoya finds Yuzuru outside, and gives her his *umbrella*.
He and Nagatsuka decide to find Shoko's old classmates, and mend what is *broken*.
Sahara, Ueno, Kawai. Every one of them is still carrying the *past*.
Ueno still hates Shoko, and she still hates Shoya for being her *friend*.
Soon, everyone meets at an amusement park, hoping to start *fresh*.
But old wounds tear open. Ueno blames Shoko, and Shoya blames *himself*.
Kawai tells Nagatsuka that Shoya was the boy who *bullied* Shoko.
Shoko hears all of it, and she starts to believe she is the reason everyone is *unhappy*.
One by one, his new friends drift away, and Shoya is *alone* again.
Over the summer, Shoko tries to hold on. She helps Shoya bake a birthday cake for her *mother*.
On the night of the fireworks, he finally asks her, when is your *birthday*?
But when the sky lights up, Shoko has already slipped *away*.
Shoya runs through the dark, and finds her standing at the edge of a *balcony*.

segments.text: God, please give me one more chance. Give me your power.

segments.say: He pulls her back to safety, but he loses his own *grip*, and falls.
Shoya sinks into a long sleep. Shoko waits by his side, and she cannot forgive *herself*.
Nagatsuka breaks down too. He never knew what a best friend was, until *Shoya*.
Shoko decides to say sorry to everyone she can, out loud, so they can really *hear* her.
Then, one night, Shoya wakes up. He runs to the bridge, and finds *Shoko* waiting.
She cries, and says she is sorry for everything. Shoya cries too, and says he is *sorry* as well.

segments.text: Hey, Nishimiya, I want you to help me live.

segments.say: They hold each other, two broken people, who finally *understand* each other.
Slowly, he heals, and the people he hurt come to his *bedside*.
At the school festival, Shoko takes his hand, and walks him to his *classroom*.
Shoya is afraid to look up. But Nagatsuka grabs him, and begs him never to go *far away*.
Kawai hands him a gift from the class, something he never got *before*.

segments.text: I've never gotten anything like this before. I'm so happy, really.

segments.say: Outside, Shoko leads him into the crowd. The festival is loud, and full of *faces*.
Then the blue X's fall away, one by one, and Shoya can finally *see* everyone.
He covers his face and cries. For the first time, the world speaks *back*.
